title: 第5章 莱茵教堂第6章 初级魔药学手札
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 次日清晨，林野推开屋门。
母亲已经出门了，早饭留在桌子上，是一碗鸡蛋手擀面。
吃过早饭后来到楼下公交站，早上的气温虽然还没上来，但也感觉有些潮湿发黏。
没几分钟，一辆标着数字‘6’的公交车驶过来。
“乘客您好，欢迎乘坐6路无人售票车，本车从北岸东站开往南岸火车站。”
“北岸天禄湖，到了。请带好随身包裹准备下车。”
车门开启的气动声过后，车载空调的凉气扑面过来。
林野刷卡上车，直接走到最后一排角落坐下。
看了一眼手机地图，红色线条标出路线，没有坐错，还有二十多站才到。
颠簸的启动过后，车辆变得平稳，周围绿化带开始倒退。
开出去没一会，一阵“铿铿铿”的破地声有些噪人。
看过去，是一个修路的施工单位，立着‘安全第一’的牌子。
“前段时间不是刚修好吗？”
“话说修了快两年了吧？说是通地铁，到现在也没通。”
车上乘客小声交谈，如果能通地铁的话，至少不用像现在这样晒太阳了。
后排，林野掏出耳机戴上。
舒缓的音乐进入耳朵，渐渐压过了工地的声音，心情放松下来。
“前方到站，南岸五悦广场。”
林野睁开眼，伸了个懒腰，调整了一下状态，把耳机摘下。
“南岸五悦广场，到了。请带好随身包裹准备下车。”
下了车，一股热气让汗毛软下去。
看了看四周，拿出手机调出导航路线。
穿行在五悦广场里，高楼耸立，很繁华。
中间一个巨型美人鱼雕塑超过二十米高，算是地标性建筑了，不少人都在雕塑前打卡拍照。
穿过广场，走过几条街道后拐进一个小巷子。
来到尽头，一个古旧黑色教堂出现在视野前方。
昨天他查过资料，莱茵教会是一个以苦痛为信仰的教会。
他们认为但凡生灵，皆有原罪。
content_en:
Early the next morning, Lin Ye opened the door.
Mother had already gone out, and breakfast was left on the table, which was a bowl of hand-made egg noodles.
After breakfast, I went to the bus stop downstairs. Although the temperature in the morning had not yet risen, I still felt a little damp and sticky.
Within a few minutes, a bus marked with the number '6' came over.
"Hello passengers, welcome to take the unmanned ticket bus No. 6. This bus runs from Bei'an East Station to Nan'an Railway Station."
"North Bank Tianlu Lake, we've arrived. Please bring your bags and get ready to get off."
"Tsk——"
After the pneumatic sound of the car door opening, the cool air from the car air conditioner hit my face.
Lin Ye swiped his card to get on the bus, walked directly to the corner of the last row and sat down.
I took a look at the map on my phone. The route was marked with red lines. I was on the right track and there were still more than 20 stops to go.
After the bumpy start, the vehicle became stable and the surrounding green belt began to reverse.
Not long after driving out, there was a loud "clang" sound breaking through the ground.
Looking over, it was a construction unit building a road, with a sign saying 'Safety First'.
"Didn't it just get repaired some time ago?"
"It's been repaired for almost two years, right? It was said that the subway was connected, but it hasn't been connected yet."
Passengers in the car talked quietly. If there was a subway, at least they wouldn't have to bask in the sun like now.
In the back row, Lin Ye took out his headphones and put them on.
The soothing music entered my ears, gradually overpowering the sound of the construction site, and I felt relaxed.
...
"The station ahead is Nan'an Wuyue Plaza."
Lin Ye opened his eyes, stretched, adjusted his posture, and took off his headphones.
"Nan'an Wuyue Plaza, we're here. Please bring your bags and get ready to get off."
"Tsk——"
After getting out of the car, a wave of heat made my hair soften.
He looked around and took out his phone to call up the navigation route.
Walking through Wuyue Square, there are tall buildings and it is very prosperous.
There is a giant mermaid sculpture in the middle that is more than 20 meters high. It is considered a landmark building. Many people check in and take photos in front of the sculpture.
Cross the square, walk down a few streets and then turn into a small alley.
At the end, an old black church appeared in front of the field of vision.
Yesterday he checked the information and found that the Rhine Church is a church that believes in suffering.
They believe that all living beings have original sin.
